assignment.task: Implement one interactive Callout variation by editing the copied source. Changes must be visible and match the direction.

direction.name: Fine Accent
direction.intent: Keep a near-paper fill and thin rounded outline. Give the existing icon and the one-pixel boundary a restrained shared accent drawn from the existing Callout theme. Keep body text neutral and avoid a thick left rail. Use an 8px radius and 12px padding as starting values. Preserve current tone distinctions without introducing a new tone palette, label, or badge.

brief.goal:
Clean up Callout styling for short contextual information. Improve compact spacing, title/body rhythm, narrow-width wrapping, and a restrained rounded boundary using the approved State Shape and Interaction Surface as visual references.

Audit: The original uses 14px body text at 1.7 line height, 12px padding, a 6px radius, a one-pixel outline and a 16px muted icon. Short notes already fit compactly. The title and body use the same font size; title weight and a 6px gap provide hierarchy. Rich paragraphs and list items have little separation inside the not-prose wrapper. Use a small scoped paragraph/list rhythm and preserve visible list markers. The primary-derived outline is stronger in dark mode. Compare quieter neutral boundaries and restrained fill while keeping text readable. A long inline-code identifier overflows at 390px in both modes. Candidates must wrap long content without hiding or shortening it.
brief.boundaries: Styling only. Preserve content, kinds, tones, icons, rich formatting and behavior. No textured headers, card layouts, new controls or schema changes. Choose one direction directly into focused tuning; no notes required on other alternatives. Start and Apply are separate explicit user actions.
preserve: Preserve info, decision, risk, warning, success, unknown-tone info fallback, free-form kind metadata, optional title, complete body, and empty-body behavior.
Keep aside semantics, tone icons, data-mdx-block, data-docs-block-type, data-source-id, CalloutDocsBlock exports, and ctx.renderMarkdown. Kind remains metadata, not a new visible badge.
Keep bold, italic, strike, inline code, links, lists, text selection, light/dark themes and narrow layouts. Preserve Docs style-rail and callout theme tokens.
Keep short contextual information compact. No card headers, texture, new controls, content rewrites or schema changes. Only the captured Callout renderer may change.

directions.name: Quiet Outline
directions.intent: Recommended starting point. Keep a single thin neutral outline, nearly paper-colored fill, 8px rounded corners, and the existing icon beside the first text line. Use 12px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Make optional title spacing and rich-body paragraph rhythm deliberate. Preserve a compact one-line note. No header band or texture.

directions.name: Soft Inset
directions.intent: Use a very subtle neutral inset fill and a lower-contrast one-pixel boundary, with 10px rounded corners. Keep the icon and text together with a slightly closer gap. Use 10px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Let the optional title supply hierarchy; keep text high contrast. No shadow, separate header, or colored card.

direction.name: Soft Inset
direction.intent: Use a very subtle neutral inset fill and a lower-contrast one-pixel boundary, with 10px rounded corners. Keep the icon and text together with a slightly closer gap. Use 10px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Let the optional title supply hierarchy; keep text high contrast. No shadow, separate header, or colored card.

brief.goal:
Clean up Callout styling for short contextual information. Improve compact spacing, title/body rhythm, narrow-width wrapping, and a restrained rounded boundary using the approved State Shape and Interaction Surface as visual references.

Audit: The original uses 14px body text at 1.7 line height, 12px padding, a 6px radius, a one-pixel outline and a 16px muted icon. Short notes already fit compactly. The title and body use the same font size; title weight and a 6px gap provide hierarchy. Rich paragraphs and list items have little separation inside the not-prose wrapper. Use a small scoped paragraph/list rhythm and preserve visible list markers. The primary-derived outline is stronger in dark mode. Compare quieter neutral boundaries and restrained fill while keeping text readable. A long inline-code identifier overflows at 390px in both modes. Candidates must wrap long content without hiding or shortening it.

directions.name: Fine Accent
directions.intent: Keep a near-paper fill and thin rounded outline. Give the existing icon and the one-pixel boundary a restrained shared accent drawn from the existing Callout theme. direction.name: Soft Inset
direction.intent: Use a very subtle neutral inset fill and a lower-contrast one-pixel boundary, with 10px rounded corners. Keep the icon and text together with a slightly closer gap. Use 10px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Let the optional title supply hierarchy; keep text high contrast. No shadow, separate header, or colored card.

brief.goal:
Clean up Callout styling for short contextual information. Improve compact spacing, title/body rhythm, narrow-width wrapping, and a restrained rounded boundary using the approved State Shape and Interaction Surface as visual references.

Audit: The original uses 14px body text at 1.7 line height, 12px padding, a 6px radius, a one-pixel outline and a 16px muted icon. Short notes already fit compactly. The title and body use the same font size; title weight and a 6px gap provide hierarchy. Rich paragraphs and list items have little separation inside the not-prose wrapper. Use a small scoped paragraph/list rhythm and preserve visible list markers. The primary-derived outline is stronger in dark mode. Compare quieter neutral boundaries and restrained fill while keeping text readable. A long inline-code identifier overflows at 390px in both modes. Candidates must wrap long content without hiding or shortening it.
brief.boundaries: Styling only. Preserve content, kinds, tones, icons, rich formatting and behavior. No textured headers, card layouts, new controls or schema changes. Choose one direction directly into focused tuning; no notes required on other alternatives. Start and Apply are separate explicit user actions.
preserve: Preserve info, decision, risk, warning, success, unknown-tone info fallback, free-form kind metadata, optional title, complete body, and empty-body behavior.
Keep aside semantics, tone icons, data-mdx-block, data-docs-block-type, data-source-id, CalloutDocsBlock exports, and ctx.renderMarkdown. Kind remains metadata, not a new visible badge.
Keep bold, italic, strike, inline code, links, lists, text selection, light/dark themes and narrow layouts. Preserve Docs style-rail and callout theme tokens.
Keep short contextual information compact. No card headers, texture, new controls, content rewrites or schema changes. Only the captured Callout renderer may change.

directions.name: Quiet Outline
directions.intent: Recommended starting point. Keep a single thin neutral outline, nearly paper-colored fill, 8px rounded corners, and the existing icon beside the first text line. Use 12px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Make optional title spacing and rich-body paragraph rhythm deliberate. Preserve a compact one-line note. No header band or texture.

directions.name: Soft Inset
directions.intent: Use a very subtle neutral inset fill and a lower-contrast one-pixel boundary, with 10px rounded corners. Keep the icon and text together with a slightly closer gap. Use 10px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Let the optional title supply hierarchy; keep text high contrast. No shadow, separate header, or colored card.

directions.name: Fine Accent
directions.intent: Keep a near-paper fill and thin rounded outline. Give the existing icon and the one-pixel boundary a restrained shared accent drawn from the existing Callout theme. Keep body text neutral and avoid a thick left rail. Use an 8px radius and 12px padding as starting values. Preserve current tone distinctions without introducing a new tone palette, label, or badge.

direction.name: Fine Accent
direction.intent: Keep a near-paper fill and thin rounded outline. Give the existing icon and the one-pixel boundary a restrained shared accent drawn from the existing Callout theme. Keep body text neutral and avoid a thick left rail. Use an 8px radius and 12px padding as starting values. Preserve current tone distinctions without introducing a new tone palette, label, or badge.

brief.goal:
Clean up Callout styling for short contextual information. Improve compact spacing, title/body rhythm, narrow-width wrapping, and a restrained rounded boundary using the approved State Shape and Interaction Surface as visual references.

Audit: The original uses 14px body text at 1.7 line height, 12px padding, a 6px radius, a one-pixel outline and a 16px muted icon. Short notes already fit compactly. The title and body use the same font size; title weight and a 6px gap provide hierarchy. Rich paragraphs and list items have little separation inside the not-prose wrapper. Use a small scoped paragraph/list rhythm and preserve visible list markers. The primary-derived outline is stronger in dark mode. Compare quieter neutral boundaries and restrained fill while keeping text readable. A long inline-code identifier overflows at 390px in both modes. Candidates must wrap long content without hiding or shortening it.
brief.boundaries: Styling only. Preserve content, kinds, tones, icons, rich formatting and behavior. No textured headers, card layouts, new controls or schema changes. Choose one direction directly into focused tuning; no notes required on other alternatives. Start and Apply are separate explicit user actions.
preserve: Preserve info, decision, risk, warning, success, unknown-tone info fallback, free-form kind metadata, optional title, complete body, and empty-body behavior.
Keep aside semantics, tone icons, data-mdx-block, data-docs-block-type, data-source-id, CalloutDocsBlock exports, and ctx.renderMarkdown. Kind remains metadata, not a new visible badge.
Keep bold, italic, strike, inline code, links, lists, text selection, light/dark themes and narrow layouts. Preserve Docs style-rail and callout theme tokens.
Keep short contextual information compact. No card headers, texture, new controls, content rewrites or schema changes. Only the captured Callout renderer may change.

directions.name: Quiet Outline
directions.intent: Recommended starting point. Keep a single thin neutral outline, nearly paper-colored fill, 8px rounded corners, and the existing icon beside the first text line. Use 12px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Make optional title spacing and rich-body paragraph rhythm deliberate. Preserve a compact one-line note. No header band or texture.

directions.name: Soft Inset
directions.intent: Use a very subtle neutral inset fill and a lower-contrast one-pixel boundary, with 10px rounded corners. Keep the icon and text together with a slightly closer gap. Use 10px vertical and 14px horizontal padding as starting values. Let the optional title supply hierarchy; keep text high contrast. No shadow, separate header, or colored card.

direction.intent: Follow .variator/reference/screenshots/mkdocs-header-reference.png. Use a softly tinted header with the existing tone icon and a bold readable title, above a separate plain body. direction.name: Colored Header · Plain Body
direction.intent: Follow .variator/reference/screenshots/mkdocs-header-reference.png. Use a softly tinted header with the existing tone icon and a bold readable title, above a separate plain body. Match the thin accent outline and rounded outer boundary. Keep body text high contrast and links visibly underlined. Inspect the captured State Shape and Interaction Surface for refinement, without adding their texture or field layouts. Use restrained tone accents: blue info, amber warning/risk, green success and violet decision. Exact tones and compact padding are implementation choices. Preserve all supplied content and use the header/body hooks listed in Preserve.

brief.goal: Use an MkDocs-style Callout: a colored header containing the tone icon and title, followed by the complete content on a plain background. Match the supplied screenshot and the refined typography, rounded boundaries, and thin borders of the approved Docs components.
brief.boundaries: One focused direction. Preserve tones, kind metadata, full content, rich formatting, text selection and links. A colored header is now explicitly requested and supersedes the earlier no-header constraint. Keep content plain, with no texture or tinted body. No schema changes or unrelated component edits. Generation waits for Start; Apply requires separate approval.
preserve: Keep info, decision, risk, warning and success tones and icons; unknown tone falls back to info. Preserve optional title and free-form kind metadata. Keep kind non-visible.

Put the existing tone icon and optional title in a colored header. If title is absent, show the tone label: Info, Decision, Risk, Warning or Success. Unknown tone uses Info. This default label is an implementer interpretation of the screenshot, not newly authored content.

Keep the complete body on the plain page background, light or dark. Preserve all bold, italic, strike, inline code, links, lists, selection, and empty-body behavior. No placeholder body or new controls.

Keep CalloutDocsBlock, ctx.renderMarkdown, aside semantics and data-source-id={data.id}. Use data-callout-header, data-callout-title and data-callout-body hooks; retain .docs-markdown for the body. Only the isolated Callout renderer is editable.

Use thin matching borders, restrained header tint, rounded outer corners and readable spacing. No texture, gradients or shadows. Keep text contrast >=4.5:1, visible link underlines, and long-content wrapping at 390px. Preserve Callout theme and typography hooks.

designIntent.intent: Repair the rejected Colored Header · Plain Body Callout by retaining the MkDocs-style tone header and plain body while giving all rich body text—including links and inline code—explicit high-contrast foreground tokens in both light and dark modes.
designIntent.layout: A single rounded, clipped aside with a one-pixel tone border. The icon and title or tone-label fallback remain in the tinted header; the complete Markdown body remains in a separate plain-background region. Existing hooks, aside semantics, source ID, tone fallback, and conditional empty-body behavior are preserved.
designIntent.spacing: Retained compact 16px horizontal header/body padding, 12px header vertical padding, 14px body vertical padding, 10px icon/title gap, and modest 0.55em rich-block rhythm. Lists retain 1.5em indentation and long content can wrap anywhere.
designIntent.typography: Retained a bold 14px/20px header and readable 14px/24px sans-serif body. Prose body, headings, lead, links, bold text, counters, bullets, quotes, and code now share an explicit accessible foreground token. Links remain visibly underlined and inline code continues to wrap.
designIntent.colors: Retained restrained blue info, violet decision, amber risk/warning, and green success accents with softly tinted headers and plain theme body backgrounds. Replaced inherited body foreground colors that failed contrast with #30343b in light mode and #e4e7eb in dark mode, and routed Tailwind Typography rich-text variables, links, and code through those tokens.
designIntent.motion: No motion or animation was introduced.
designIntent.interactions: Text selection, rendered Markdown formatting, keyboard-focusable links, visible link underlines, and long-content wrapping are retained. No controls or new interaction surfaces were added.

decisions.handling: Applied within its original Callout styling scope: this repair only changes isolated Callout foreground styling and preserves purpose, content, supported tones, metadata, and behavior.
Applied within Callout scope through the retained compact typography, restrained tone colors, rounded clipping, and thin border; no reference field geometry or texture was copied.

Retained as a superseded historical decision. Short-context suitability remains compatible; its no-header aspect is non-applicable to this direction because the later explicit colored-header decision supersedes it.
Previously satisfied by the surrounding Variator workflow; it does not require or justify an additional renderer change in this contrast repair.
Applied as one focused repair to the selected direction, without alternatives, per-alternative notes, or an Apply action.
Applied: no Apply action was taken and no sessions, approved reference components, or unrelated files were edited.
Retained as a superseded first-round interpretation. Its wrapping and modest rich-body rhythm remain carried forward; its no-header framing remains non-applicable after the colored-header reset.
Applied directly and preserved during repair: icon and title remain in the softly colored header while all rendered content remains in the separate plain-background body.
Applied and preserved: one MkDocs-style treatment, tone-label fallback for missing titles, non-visible kind metadata, restrained tint, matching one-pixel border, and plain body background.

choices: Builder choice: use explicit neutral body foregrounds (#30343b light, #e4e7eb dark) rather than relying on the host foreground token that produced measured 3.50:1 and 3.94:1 failures.
Builder choice: set Tailwind Typography variables at the Callout body boundary so nested rich marks inherit accessible color without flattening their semantic formatting.
Builder choice: explicitly color links and inline code with the same high-contrast token while retaining underline and wrapping treatments.
tradeoffs: The neutral body colors are intentionally fixed for predictable contrast rather than inheriting potentially lower-contrast host prose colors.
Links use underline rather than a separate accent hue, prioritizing reliable contrast and recognition across both themes.
This focused repair does not alter header palette, dimensions, content behavior, or unrelated components.

designIntent.intent: Repair the rejected Colored Header · Plain Body Callout by retaining the MkDocs-style tone header and plain body while giving all rich body text—including links and inline code—explicit high-contrast foreground tokens in both light and dark modes.
designIntent.layout: A single rounded, clipped aside with a one-pixel tone border. The icon and title or tone-label fallback remain in the tinted header; the complete Markdown body remains in a separate plain-background region. Existing hooks, aside semantics, source ID, tone fallback, and conditional empty-body behavior are preserved.
designIntent.spacing: Retained compact 16px horizontal header/body padding, 12px header vertical padding, 14px body vertical padding, 10px icon/title gap, and modest 0.55em rich-block rhythm. Lists retain 1.5em indentation and long content can wrap anywhere.
designIntent.typography: Retained a bold 14px/20px header and readable 14px/24px sans-serif body. Prose body, headings, lead, links, bold text, counters, bullets, quotes, and code now share an explicit accessible foreground token. Links remain visibly underlined and inline code continues to wrap.
designIntent.colors: Retained restrained blue info, violet decision, amber risk/warning, and green success accents with softly tinted headers and plain theme body backgrounds. Replaced inherited body foreground colors that failed contrast with #30343b in light mode and #e4e7eb in dark mode, and routed Tailwind Typography rich-text variables, links, and code through those tokens.
designIntent.motion: No motion or animation was introduced.
designIntent.interactions: Text selection, rendered Markdown formatting, keyboard-focusable links, visible link underlines, and long-content wrapping are retained. No controls or new interaction surfaces were added.

decisions.handling: Applied within its original Callout styling scope: this repair only changes isolated Callout foreground styling and preserves purpose, content, supported tones, metadata, and behavior.
Applied within Callout scope through the retained compact typography, restrained tone colors, rounded clipping, and thin border; no reference field geometry or texture was copied.

Retained as a superseded historical decision. Short-context suitability remains compatible; its no-header aspect is non-applicable to this direction because the later explicit colored-header decision supersedes it.
Previously satisfied by the surrounding Variator workflow; it does not require or justify an additional renderer change in this contrast repair.
Applied as one focused repair to the selected direction, without alternatives, per-alternative notes, or an Apply action.
Applied: no Apply action was taken and no sessions, approved reference components, or unrelated files were edited.
Retained as a superseded first-round interpretation. Its wrapping and modest rich-body rhythm remain carried forward; its no-header framing remains non-applicable after the colored-header reset.
Applied directly and preserved during repair: icon and title remain in the softly colored header while all rendered content remains in the separate plain-background body.
Applied and preserved: one MkDocs-style treatment, tone-label fallback for missing titles, non-visible kind metadata, restrained tint, matching one-pixel border, and plain body background.

choices: Builder choice: use explicit neutral body foregrounds (#30343b light, #e4e7eb dark) rather than relying on the host foreground token that produced measured 3.50:1 and 3.94:1 failures.
Builder choice: set Tailwind Typography variables at the Callout body boundary so nested rich marks inherit accessible color without flattening their semantic formatting.
Builder choice: explicitly color links and inline code with the same high-contrast token while retaining underline and wrapping treatments.
tradeoffs: The neutral body colors are intentionally fixed for predictable contrast rather than inheriting potentially lower-contrast host prose colors.
Links use underline rather than a separate accent hue, prioritizing reliable contrast and recognition across both themes.
This focused repair does not alter header palette, dimensions, content behavior, or unrelated components.

rounds.intent: Clean up Callout styling for short contextual information. Improve compact spacing, title/body rhythm, narrow-width wrapping, and a restrained rounded boundary using the approved State Shape and Interaction Surface as visual references.
rounds.boundaries: Styling only. Preserve content, kinds, tones, icons, rich formatting and behavior. No textured headers, card layouts, new controls or schema changes. Choose one direction directly into focused tuning; no notes required on other alternatives. Start and Apply are separate explicit user actions.

rounds.intent: Use an MkDocs-style Callout: a colored header containing the tone icon and title, followed by the complete content on a plain background. Match the supplied screenshot and the refined typography, rounded boundaries, and thin borders of the approved Docs components.
rounds.boundaries: One focused direction. Preserve tones, kind metadata, full content, rich formatting, text selection and links. A colored header is now explicitly requested and supersedes the earlier no-header constraint. Keep content plain, with no texture or tinted body. No schema changes or unrelated component edits. Generation waits for Start; Apply requires separate approval.
